chunks.text: Employees receive fifteen vacation days each year. Vacation requests must be submitted through the employee portal.
Remote work equipment must be returned when employment ends. Contact workplace operations for shipping instructions.
Receipts are required for business expenses over twenty-five dollars. Submit receipts with the monthly expense report.
Air travel should use economy class unless a documented medical accommodation has been approved.
Report suspected phishing email immediately to the security team. Do not open unexpected attachments or links.

queries.query: How do employees submit vacation requests?
